name: Example Dashboard - V10.0.0
description: The v10.0.0 live grid: real-time quotes over a websocket, the subscription list that feeds it, and the kdb+ tick history behind one symbol. Needs the live-grid backend configured; every widget here is served by it.

name: Example Dashboard - Version 12.0.0
description: The v12.0.0 advanced chart: NVIDIA on live kdb+ candles with server-computed studies, six drawing tools and a trade-true anchored VWAP. Underneath it, the v10 Live quotes grid carrying v12's two new columns for the same symbols — RSI as a 0-100 heat-bar with guides at 30/50/70, and vs VWAP as a signed bar showing each symbol's deviation from its anchored VWAP. Both are computed server-side by the same polars engine the chart uses, so the grid's RSI is the same Wilder RSI(14) the chart plots and its VWAP is the same trade-true value — one convention, not two. IMPORTANT: this dashboard needs openbb-docker running on THIS machine. The advanced chart reads the kdb+ tick cache on a loopback websocket — q IPC shares that port and executes arbitrary code with no auth, so it is never served or funnelled — which means the backend it points at must have a tick cache URL set in Connections. Against a remote stack the chart card explains why it cannot draw rather than showing an empty plot; the grid and its two columns still work, since they come over ordinary HTTP.
